sources.title: Common CMM Inspection Errors
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 雷射追蹤儀大尺寸量測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：原始值未覆蓋，修正方向與單位正確，未把修正量等同量測不確定度。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Raw values remain, correction sign/units are correct, and correction magnitude is not equated with uncertainty.
related.difference: 把角度誤差換成橫向位置誤差，建立測站配置的量化比較。
related.differenceEn: Convert angular error into transverse position error for quantitative station-layout comparison.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 均溫細長件L(T)=Lref[1+αΔT]；溫度梯度、夾持與機台幾何誤差不包含在此式。 教學Lref=500 mm，α=11.5×10^−6/K，ΔT=3 K，參考溫度僅作課內基準。 ΔL=500×11.5×10^−6×3=0.01725 mm；熱態長500.01725 mm，反算應除以1.0000345。
小角度下u_trans≈R uθ，與獨立徑向u_r合成u=√(u_r²+u_trans²)；真實三維協方差另處理。 合成距離R=10 m、角度標準不確定度10 μrad、徑向0.03 mm。 橫向u=10×10^−5 m=0.10 mm；合成√(0.03²+0.10²)=0.104403 mm。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For a uniform-temperature slender part, L(T)=Lref[1+αΔT]; gradients, fixturing and machine geometry are excluded. Teaching reference length 500 mm,α11.5×10^−6/K,ΔT 3 K, with an explicitly chosen classroom reference temperature. ΔL=0.01725 mm; hot length 500.01725 mm, inverted by dividing by 1.0000345.

For small angles, u_trans≈R u θ; combine independent radialu_r by RSS, with full 3D covariance separate. Synthetic range 10 m, angular uncertainty 10 μ rad, radial uncertainty 0.03 mm. Transverseu=0.10 mm; combinedu=0.104403 mm.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.difference: 由關節角推回末端座標，理解相對角和絕對角的差異。
related.differenceEn: Recover endpoint coordinates from joint angles and distinguish relative from absolute angles.

比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For a uniform-temperature slender part, L(T)=Lref[1+αΔT]; gradients, fixturing and machine geometry are excluded. Teaching reference length 500 mm,α11.5×10^−6/K,ΔT 3 K, with an explicitly chosen classroom reference temperature. ΔL=0.01725 mm; hot length 500.01725 mm, inverted by dividing by 1.0000345.
x=L1 cosθ1+L2 cos(θ1+θ2), y=L1 sinθ1+L2 sin(θ1+θ2).; Teaching links are L1=0.30 m and L2=0.20 m, with θ1=30° and θ2=60°.; x=0.30 cos30°+0.20 cos90°=0.259808 m; y=0.15+0.20=0.35 m.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
